map.依据国家知识产权局 2024 年现行商标业务收费标准，输入申请类别与项目数量，计: Based on the CNIPA's 2024 trademark service fee standards, enter the number of classes and items to compute official fees for registration, renewal and other services, helping budget application costs.
map.申请商标注册前，按类别数与商品项数估算官费。: Before applying, estimate official fees from the number of classes and items.
map.每类限定 10 个商品/服务项目，超出每个加收规费。: Each class is limited to 10 goods/services items, with an extra fee per item beyond that.
map.续展、转让、变更、异议等不同类型费用不同。: Renewal, transfer, change, opposition and other types have different fees.
map.：商标注册规费 300 元/类（限定 10 个商品/服务项目），未超项则官费 3: : the trademark registration official fee is 300 CNY per class (limited to 10 goods/services items), so without exceeding the item count the fee is 300 CNY.
map.：同 1 类 15 个商品：300 + 超 5 项 × 30 元 = 450 元: : 15 goods in the same 1 class: 300 + 5 excess items × 30 = 450 CNY; the renewal official fee is about 500 CNY per class (per the latest announcement).
map.官费只是申请成本，核准与否取决于近似查询与审查；建议委托代理做近似检索提高成功率: The official fee is only the application cost; approval depends on similarity search and examination. Consider engaging an agent for a similarity search to improve the chance of success.
map.变更和续展收费一样吗？: Are change and renewal fees the same?
map.不一样，变更、续展、转让、异议各有规费标准，且网上申请与纸质申请、集体/证明商标: No. Change, renewal, transfer and opposition each have their own fee standards, and online vs paper applications and collective/certification marks differ in rate—defer to the official website.
